review_notes: Inspected all 134 lines, the imported coinduction definitions, Mathlib's coextension and DFinsupp interfaces, and downstream uses in NonGeneration.lean. The proposed addition was not tested with Lean.

findings.excerpt:
def coindBasisMap (V : ModuleCat.{u} k) (b : Basis ι k V) :
    (Π₀ _ : ι, DA k R) →ₗ[R] coind k R V := by
  classical
  exact DFinsupp.lsum ℤ (fun i => coindLine V (b i))
findings.problem: The wrapper lacks a canonical simp rule on DFinsupp generators. The surjectivity proof consequently unfolds coindBasisMap to reduce its application to each single. The desired normal form of `coindBasisMap V b (DFinsupp.single i φ)` is `coindLine V (b i) φ`, not an expansion through lsum and sumAddHom.
findings.proposed_change: Add `@[simp] lemma coindBasisMap_single [DecidableEq ι] (V : ModuleCat.{u} k) (b : Basis ι k V) (i : ι) (φ : DA k R) : coindBasisMap (R := R) V b (DFinsupp.single i φ) = coindLine V (b i) φ`, without a finite-dimensionality assumption. Prove it by unfolding coindBasisMap and using DFinsupp.lsum_single. Use this rule with map_sum in the surjectivity proof instead of unfolding the definition there.
findings.benefit: Provides stable simplification on generators while keeping arbitrary DFinsupp inputs unexpanded. Subsequent evaluation uses the existing coindLine_apply rule. The orientation removes coindBasisMap and introduces no reverse rewrite; zero coefficients remain compatible with map_zero, and empty index types require no special case.

evidence.excerpt:
have hx : coindBasisMap V b x = ∑ i ∈ s, coindLine V (b i) (c i) := by
      simp only [x, map_sum, coindBasisMap, DFinsupp.lsum_single]

theorem lsum_single [Semiring S] [Module S N] [SMulCommClass R S N] (F : ∀ i, M i →ₗ[R] N) (i)
    (x : M i) : lsum S F (single i x) = F i x := by
  simp

@[simp] lemma coindLine_apply (V : ModuleCat.{u} k) (v : V) (φ : DA k R) (r : R) :
    coindLine V v φ r = φ r • v := rfl
